title: charistemma fastigiata
intro: Charistemma fastigiata, commonly known as the yellow trumpetvine, is a flowering plant native to tropical regions of Asia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing fever, relieving respiratory issues, and aiding in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Charistemma fastigiata are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. Bioactive constituents found in this plant include flavonoids and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
